title: Herbal Crispy Mediterranean Corn Salad
description: A fresh, herb‑laden corn salad with creamy dressing, crunchy roasted chickpeas, and tangy pickled cucumbers—perfect for meal prep and nut‑free diets.

ingredients.name: roasted chickpeas
ingredients.notes: Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper and roast at 200 °C (400 °F) for 20 min until crisp

instructions: Preheat oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Toss the ½ cup chickpeas with 1 Tbsp olive oil, ½ tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20 min, stirring halfway, until golden and crispy. Remove and set aside to cool.
In a large bowl, whisk together Greek yogurt, mayonnaise, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, honey, ½ tsp salt, and ½ tsp pepper until smooth.
Fold in the cooked corn kernels, diced pickled cucumbers, chopped parsley, dill, and oregano.
Gently stir in the cooled roasted chickpeas, reserving a handful for topping.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 min to allow flavors to meld.
Just before serving, sprinkle the reserved chickpeas over the top for extra crunch.
Serve chilled as a satisfying lunch or side dish.
